research.title: shadcn/ui Became a Distribution System. Registries, registry:base and Agent Skills.
research.whyTrending: CLI v4 (March 2026) lets a registry ship an entire design system as one payload via registry:base — components, deps, CSS vars, fonts and config in a single install. May 2026 added registry include for composing large registries from multiple registry.json files, plus registry validate for pre-publish checks. Base UI is now the default primitive, and shadcn/skills feeds coding agents the context they need to use components and registries correctly. The docs describe the features; nobody has written the 'ship your company's design system as a private registry' walkthrough.
research.gapNote: Huge search volume, zero coverage. Links naturally to the atomic design and design-token posts.
